name: Santa Ana Volcano & Lake Coatepeque Private Tour 🌋
description: Experience an unforgettable adventure hiking El Salvador’s highest and most iconic volcano, followed by relaxing time at the breathtaking Lake Coatepeque.
itinerary: 🕕 6:00 AM – Hotel pick-up (San Salvador) 🚐 Departure toward Parque Nacional Cerro Verde.
🕗 8:00 AM – Arrival and introductory briefing with local park guide.
🥾 8:15 AM – Start of the hike to Volcán de Santa Ana (Ilamatepec).
🌋 10:00 AM – Arrival at the summit. Time to relax, enjoy a snack, explore the turquoise crater, and take breathtaking photos.
⬇️ 10:30 AM – Begin descent.
🍽️ 1:00 PM – Optional lunch at a lakeside restaurant at Lago de Coatepeque (not included). Optional activities available such as kayaking, boat rides, or jet skis.
🚐 2:30 PM – Return to San Salvador.
🏨 3:45 PM (approx.) – Hotel drop-off.
included: ✔ Entrance fees to the national park
not_included: ✖ Optional water activities at the lake

name: Joya de Cerén & San Andrés Private Tour 🏛️
description: Travel back in time and discover two of the most important Maya archaeological sites in El Salvador on this half-day cultural experience.
itinerary: 🕖 7:00 AM – Hotel pick-up (San Salvador) 🚐 Departure toward the archaeological sites.
🕘 9:00 AM – Arrival at Joya de Cerén, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known as the “Pompeii of the Americas.”
🕤 9:15 AM – Guided tour of the remarkably preserved ancient Maya village buried by volcanic ash.
📸 10:30 AM – Free time for photos and exploration.
🚐 11:30 AM – Transfer to San Andrés.
🏛️ 12:00 PM – Guided visit of the ceremonial center, plazas, and main pyramid structures.
🍽️ 1:00 PM – Optional lunch at a local restaurant (not included).
🚐 2:30 PM – Return to San Salvador.
🏨 3:30 PM (approx.) – Hotel drop-off.
included: ✔ Entrance fees to both archaeological sites
